notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting 5 (+2)': My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal, Coruscant: Galactic Senate, Tatooine: Desert Landing Site, Prepared Defenses and Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans; all counted in the 60. The '+2' are the Prepared Defenses Effects chosen per matchup from the Effects section (the parenthetical 'start against…' remarks are matchup notes).

This is the earlier version of Falke's 'MylordMartin Is That Legal - now even better' (DeckTech 19016, 20 September 2001). The later list swaps Death Star II: Docking Bay, Death Star II: Throne Room, the 3rd Marker, IG-88 In IG-2000, Motion Supported and Evader & Monnok for Death Star, Executor: Docking Bay, Tatooine: Cantina, Grand Admiral Thrawn, Chimaera and Search And Destroy.

Posted 'MylordMartin, is that legal?' dested the Objective; 'Senat' the Dark Coruscant: Galactic Senate; 'Maul`s Hut' dested Tatooine: Desert Landing Site (the objective's other [Episode I] location, as in 19016 and 19189).

Posted 'DS2 DB' dested Death Star II: Docking Bay; 'DS2 Throne Room (Imm. to Rev.)' Death Star II: Throne Room (the parenthetical notes it is immune to Revolution); '3rd Marker' the Dark Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker); 'Mos Espa DB' and 'Kashyyyk' the Dark pages.

Posted 'Ig88 in Ship' dested IG-88 In IG-2000; 'Maul`s Ship' Maul's Sith Infiltrator; 'Bobafett in S1' Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Zuckuss in MH' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Vader with Saber' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Darth Maul' (x3) the Tatooine Darth Maul; 'Dr. E/Ponda Baba' Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba; 'Evader/Monnok' the combo Interrupt Evader & Monnok.

Posted 'Imp. Arr. Ord./Secret Plans', 'TINT / OE' and 'Ability, A., A.' dested Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement and Ability, Ability, Ability; misspellings 'Allergations', 'perferfectly' and 'Concceded' dested Allegations Of Corruption, Our Blockade Is Perfectly Legal and The Point Is Conceded.
The numbered list '61.'–'70.' after the strategy ('Some nice card for a seventy cards deck') and Sim Aloo ('the 71th card') are optional extras, not part of the 60.
The strategy mentions playing against Bastian Winkelhaus at 'Continentals' (the 2001 European Championship; see Winkelhaus's DeckTech 18727).
